in_marathi.name: Chandrima
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandrima हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandrima is a Sanskrit name derived from the word Chandrama, which means moon. In Hindu mythology, Chandrima is the name of the goddess of the moon. She is also known as Soma, Saraswati, and Lakshmi. Chandrima is believed to bring peace, prosperity, and happiness. She is often depicted as a young woman with a full moon on her forehead. Chandrima is revered for her calming influence and is invoked for peace, tranquility, and protection.
